task.request: 设计一个可玩的打飞机小游戏的三个不同关卡，逐步提高压力，方向键/WASD移动、空格/鼠标开火，完成清敌目标；交付三份原生关卡配置，披露假设和局限。
task.scope: Content design only; the same supervisor-owned engine/render host assembles both submitted configurations after generation. No engine implementation ability comparison.

rules.controls: Aim at visible enemies and fire; avoid enemy/projectile contact.
rules.goal: Destroy every enemy, survive. Failure on lost health or timeout.

task.gate: Valid configs, 3 structurally distinct levels, browser real-input win/loss/restart/pause/mobile, unchanged numeric target 0.5..0.9 reported separately.

rubric.instruction: Review only visible anonymous artifacts and supplied measurements. Scores are model judgments, never human experience scores.

dimensions.progression_support: 0 no evidence,1 mixed/limited,2 observable stage differentiation with sensible measured pressure progression
dimensions.clarity: 0 unclear,1 some ambiguity,2 goals/controls/state clear in evidence
dimensions.evidence_honesty: 0 unsupported claims,1 limitations incomplete,2 observed facts and uncertainty distinguished

rubric.pass_gate: No new numerical acceptance threshold; retain original numeric-band verdicts and actual failures.

design: One pair, content-design comparison with shared neutral post-submission rendering. Not the formal full_skill intervention, no population/statistical effect claim. Generation and judgment use distinct fresh contexts; exactly two proxy judges.
token_budget_evidence: UNVERIFIED; no usage telemetry from host subagents
